contexts: 700-bed hospital trauma unit, about 420 hip fractures a year
reading: Early mobilisation sits on a path where the reasons for delay (hypotension, delirium) also lengthen stays, so a crude comparison overstates benefit and heavy adjustment may understate it. Weekend staffing is the one reason for delay that does not depend on the patient, which makes it a useful check. Trial benefit comes from selected patients with seven-day cover; the unit's patients include many the trials left out.
